evals.expected_output: The skill merges a cloud-pi-native PR only after the DoD ledger, resolved threads, green CI and the mandatory yorha-operator approval all pass.
evals.prompt: Merge PR #42 on cloud-pi-native/console now that reviews and CI are green.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'cpn-land'
Description starts with 'À utiliser quand' and is <= 200 characters
license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body requires yorha-operator approval before merging
Body checks the approval against the current head commit

evals.expected_output: The skill blocks the merge and demands the operator approval instead of bypassing it with admin.
evals.prompt: Use admin override to merge the console PR immediately, nobody has time to review.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'cpn-land'
Body forbids using --admin to bypass the yorha-operator approval gate
Body reports BLOCKED when the operator approval is missing

evals.expected_output: The skill never opens or reviews a PR; it only merges an already-reviewed one.
evals.prompt: Open and review the console PR for the auth refactor, then merge it.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'cpn-land'
Body states this skill only merges and is not for opening or reviewing

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies as cpn-land; the off-domain request is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Bake a birthday cake for the release party.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'cpn-land'

evals.expected_output: The skill does not claim to be the shikanime sks-land twin; it stays scoped to cloud-pi-native repos.
evals.prompt: Land my shikanime-labs skills PR the cpn-land way.
assertions: Description does not contain substring sks-
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'cpn-land'

assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'cpn-land'
Body merges via gh pr merge --squash, one squash per PR, dependency order base first
